reviews.review_text: A "must" in Lima to enjoy many of the great classics of Peruvian cuisine.  Reservations are not allowed. We have to wait. Wait, it'll be worth it.
reviews.title: Fresh and fun

reviews.review_text: Delicious. When we got there, we were told the wait time was 2 hour. It actually ended up being longer. We ended up taking an uber from there to the beach front walking area which was a good idea! highly recommend doing that if the wait is long when you get on the waiting list. The food was delicious and the service was amazing once we were seated! Even our two kids thought the food was amazing and worth the wait!
reviews.title: Best Cevicheria! Totally worth the wait!

reviews.review_text: Wonderful restaurant, super careful and quick service. Everything we experienced was excellent!!! Super recommend
reviews.title: Nice atmosphere and wonderful food

reviews.review_text: Out of this world delicious ceviche clásico and octopus À la Brasa! We are coming back to explore more of the menu. So so good!!
reviews.title: Delicious fresh seafood!!

reviews.review_text: Great ceviche, excellent cocktails and attentive service. The waterfront setting adds a relaxed and elegant touch to the dining experience.
reviews.title: Modern Peruvian Cuisine

reviews.review_text: Everything perfect, from the care to the dishes. We ate a kind of shrimp moqueca that wasn't on the menu we saw on Instagram wonderful and the dessert was the best of our lives. Churros fried full of ice cream and wonderful fruits
reviews.title: Worth how much it weighs

reviews.review_text: The best seafood in the country without a doubt. From the entrance you are greeted with great friendliness and both food and service are TOP
reviews.title: Late, folks.

reviews.review_text: The ceviche is fresh and tastes very good, the portions just right and the Mood always lively. Sometimes you have to wait a while to get a table and the Service can delay when it is full, but it is worth it for the Quality of food. The prices are a little high, although according to experience. Overall, a very good place to enjoy seafood and Peruvian food in a relaxed Mood.
reviews.title: Good ceviche

reviews.review_text: Lively Miraflores spot where ultra fresh cebiche, tiraditos and a sharp pisco sour lead the show service is quick, portions are shareable, and a daytime reservation helps come hungry and start with the clasico.
reviews.title: Cebiche Central

reviews.review_text: We have eaten at La Mar Cebichería as a first introduction in Lima, and there is no better way to introduce yourself to good Peruvian food, all excellent, very well served by Juan José Ruiz.
reviews.title: GREAT RESTAURANT

reviews.review_text: Great food and service, convenient to Miraflores hotels. They're one of the few good restaurants open on a Sunday and don't require a reservation (they don't take them at all; as a result the wait times are long). Popular with the locals as well as tourists. I recommend the Causa Limena as an entree and the chocolate cake for dessert (made with chocolate from 3 different regions in Peru), with maybe an empanada for an appetizer. Sharing (para compartir) is acceptable.
reviews.title: A cuilinary experience you won't forget

reviews.review_text: Whenever you go to sea, apart from trying fresh things at their best, the cooking technique is impressive, I will not tire of visiting them
reviews.title: Impressive

reviews.review_text: Way overated, do not live up to the hype, the last 3 time I not been happy and decided I not give it anymore changes. Don't let you fool of signs hanging in the bar 50best resturant it as far as I now never been on the list and it's falls appertize. If you want good fish the Peruvian way even for a great price head to PuntoAzul
reviews.title: Highly overrated

reviews.review_text:
We stayed at La Mar Cebichería in Lima and the experience was spectacular. The friendly atmosphere, professionalism and kindness of the staff won us over. The quality of the dishes is very high, from ceviche to pasta with hedgehogs, from soups to desserts, all balanced and surprising.
A restaurant that combines tradition and creativity under the guidance of the great chef Gastón Acurio, a true ambassador of Peruvian cuisine. Absolutely not to be missed in Lima!
reviews.title: A jewel of Peruvian cuisine

reviews.review_text: Fantastic fish and seafood place. The atmosphere is relaxed and the staff very attentive and helpful. We chose the tasting menu, which was entirely about sea urchins: 13 courses, all delicious. The tasting menu was not cheap but the price/quality ratio was excellent. Ceviche was much cheaper. Highly recommended.
reviews.title: Best fish/seafood in Lima

reviews.review_text: If you want to taste the good taste of fish on the coast after an inland trip, coming to the Sea is mandatory. The hard part is going to be choosing what to eat from everything they offer. In our case we chose the trio of cebiches and we loved it. There is a wide variety of fresh fish and they have special dishes according to season. Mood is relaxed and good vibes are generated with the music. The price is high but correct for what they offer. Good option if you want to try any restaurant in Acurio, other than Tanta. We went at 13:30 and waited 30 minutes. But as of 14:00 they were already told 1h or more.
reviews.title: Mandatory visit

reviews.review_text: Fantastic restaurant, excellent food, differentiated. The service is very attentive, we expected a lot in the queue, but it was worth waiting.
reviews.title: Food and differentiated care. Excellent.

reviews.review_text: Ideal to go in large groups to lunch, order different dishes and taste everything... hearty and delicious food. Chef Gaston present and greeting some of his diners, Mood pleasant and with a musical selection of salsa that only fills with joy and feeling of abundance
reviews.title: Lima top for lunch with friends or family

reviews.review_text:
I've been there twice, and it's still a good choice for seafood. Ceviche, seafood rice, and others like chaufa rice with picanha are very good, and the noodles are delicious. The parmesan shells are very dry.
The place is very noisy and the tables are very close together.
Otherwise it is recommended.
reviews.title: Traditional in Lima

reviews.review_text: The best I've tried in Lima, elegant ceviche, delicious octopus in olive oil, and chicharron de pescado, all at the right temperature, with the right portions, pleasant music, Sammy's service, a very nice atmosphere, very friendly hosts, a luxury. Thank you.
reviews.title: The sea was calm and beautiful

reviews.review_text: We loved the food from this place!!: a very professional and friendly treatment and exquisite flavors. The price for being Lima is somewhat more expensive than elsewhere but it is well worth it. We ordered 2 first, a large grilled fish (I recommend it), a dessert and 4 waters, 110€. For my taste, the best place we ate in Lima!!
reviews.title: Spectacular flavors!!

reviews.review_text: Delicious ceviches! Restaurant crowded! Everything worked super well! The price is super higher according to the quality of the dishes!!! I recommend!
reviews.title: Very good!

reviews.review_text:
- The atmosphere is extremely noisy, which generates discomfort (volume of the music excessively loud).
- The tastes clearly well achieved, classic, but at the same time without novelties and without surprises; nothing that in any other cevicheria, less recognized, can not be found.
- Attention; I perceived the rush to present the background dish, when it was still in the middle of the entrance (it should be mentioned that there were a lot of people waiting outside the restaurant), you had to give continuity to the "production line".
First impression, disappointing.
reviews.title: Disappointment on first visit.

reviews.review_text:
Wonderful service and the food is not even spoken. Everything we asked for was wonderful. A
Highlight for the chocolate mousse with quinoua and for the vieiras.
reviews.title: Service and wonderful food

reviews.review_text:
"La Mar Cebichería" in Lima, Peru, is undoubtedly a jewel of Peruvian cuisine and a must for seafood lovers. The freshness of the ingredients is unparalleled, and the ceviche is simply divine, with a perfect balance of flavors. The menu offers a variety of creative dishes that enhance the country's culinary tradition, making each visit a unique experience. 

The atmosphere is informal but welcoming, with attentive and friendly service that makes every guest special. La Mar is the ideal place to enjoy authentic food in a lively environment. I highly recommend trying the classic ceviche, accompanied by a fresh pisco sour for a complete dining experience. A real treasure for culinary connoisseurs!
reviews.title: 5 stars excellent fish

reviews.review_text: Nice atmosphere ... excellent service ... we ate ceviche that was delicious ... a delicious seafood plate ... we sat in the bar, watching the fresh fish next to us on ice ... very good the truth would go again ... ahhh dessert , homemade lucuma ice cream ... A delight 👏👏👏👏
reviews.title: Excellent

reviews.review_text: Excellent service! Food and drinks of good quality! We were taken care of by Ivan, who gave full attention and clarifications about dishes and drinks.
reviews.title: Super pleasant environment

reviews.review_text: The food was quite good, I ordered a ceviche with its respective chicha morada and it was perfect. We had to wait a long time, but they always brought us potatoes and sweet potato for the wait which gives them another point. Nice bathrooms, but a bit dirty and the place is quite cozy.
reviews.title: Good Chicha morada and ceviche

reviews.review_text: Excellent place , care , decoration and especially the ceviche prepared with great ingredients and fresh fish
reviews.title: La Mar Cebichería - A unique gastronomic experience

reviews.review_text:
Excellent place to try a Peruvian food! There is a big menu - you’ll definitely not be disappointed with your choice. Many ceviche options (mixto is cool), different sashimi (tuna toro is excellent), cold and hot appetizers, raws (tiraditos trio is awesome), grill, dishes with rice and other main dishes. Everything is very tasty: fresh fish, big portions, nice serving. 
There are different cocktails: of course, classic ones (pisco sour is the best) and good variety of signature cocktails. There are beers, wines and liquors as well.
There are many seating places. The restaurant is very popular, but they don’t offer reservations, sometimes you have to wait some time. It’s rather convenient - they offer small tables, so you can order some drinks and snacks.
reviews.title: Iconic ceviche and cool cocktails

reviews.review_text:
We arrive at 12 noon because there is usually waiting to get place (they do not take reservations) and we enter without waiting.
First class service, amazing food, spectacular drinks
The best dining experience of my life!!
reviews.title: The best dining experience of my life!!

reviews.review_text: Good was really good, we did not like the Causa with crab, it was not good tbh. The rest just amazing! Service was in another lever and their cocktails wow! Highly recommended
reviews.title: La Mar Experience

reviews.review_text: Since we went to lime we knew we wanted to go to the sea to eat. Excellent reference to local food , delicious and varied flavors. Portions are large so they can be shared between 2 people. Very good service very friendly waiters and very nice atmosphere. They sell chef's books. The chocolate mousse dessert was the richest!
reviews.title: Peruvian food reference

reviews.review_text: The place is relaxed, mainly by the decoration and music. The ceviches are amazing. I recommend the black shells and the oatmeal, the latter for those who want to taste something different. Drinks also leave nothing to be desired. The care of wily was sensational, everything he recommended, worked in full! But do not arrive very hungry, as there is no reservation of tables and the wait on the weekend was about 1 hour. Still, I recommend and would return.
reviews.title: Imperdible - great ceviches and relaxed place

reviews.review_text: The food and atmosphere were great. However I was really disappointed with the behaviour of the hostess girl. When we arrived we were told the waiting time is around 20 mins which was fine as we knew there is no reservation option here. When we sat down at the table the hostess Carolina completely ignored me and in the middle of the service she came over to my husband and handed him a paper with her phone number and email address written down saying that he can call her next time he wants to come, she can reserve a spot for him. At no point she mentioned me. He thanked her politely and handed me the note. I thought it was weird as there is no reservation system and I wondered why she wants to prioritise him? I added her number on my WhatsApp and her photo came up - half naked in a bikini! This made my visit very uncomfortable and I thought it was very unprofessional and I wonder how many guys she hands these notes to on daily basis? I still have the note, in case I want to book a slot! If I ever fancy to be disrespected again? The management needs to be more careful when selecting employees because incidents like this can put off their customers. We visited Peru, Lima in February this year again but did not go to La Mar. Shame because the restaurant has a nice concept.
reviews.title: Hostess gave her number to my husband out of nowhere

reviews.review_text: On weekends you can't make reservations, but it's worth it. You have to get used to the volume in the attractively designed restaurant. Very delicious and well prepared seafood and Peruvian classics, such as Causa, Suspiro Limeño, Cebiches etc. All food prepared in an exemplary way, seasoned and arranged. But: Both men’s and women’s toilets were unkempt and despite addressing the supervisor nothing happened. In comparison, yesterday at the somewhat larger restaurant “Siete Sopas” on the corner of Petit Thouars - José Pardo, a drip-free, fussy floor in the men’s room. Therefore, unfortunately, I have to deduct 2 points in the evaluation
reviews.title: Very delicious food but unkempt toilets

reviews.review_text: This place was so beautiful and I went because the reviews were rated very highly but since I got there, it was around the time they were closing 5:00pm I ordered scallops, the seafood and rice and the food was not cooked all the way, which resolved in me having some stomach issues. The people were so friendly, but make sure your food is cooked all the way.
reviews.title: Beautiful Restaurant but first impression not so well

reviews.review_text: You can eat fresher seafood than in Japan! Camarero is also very kind and friendly! The clean kitchen is full of activity. We enjoyed a great Lima lunch!
reviews.title: Great satisfaction.

reviews.review_text: Got there at 11:30 am and a line quickly formed before it opened at noon. The dishes were fresh and delicious. The included chips and dipping sauces should be an order able dish by itself - SO Yummy!  We had the ceviche Classico and the ceviche mantora based on our waitress’ recommendation and it was SO GOOD. Our main dishes were just as good (the causa is huge). The open air ambiance was refreshing even on a cloudy muggy day.  Would definitely recommend!!
reviews.title: Fresh and delicious!!

reviews.review_text:
Having come here for the first time, it was an amazing experience. Our waitress Isabel was outstanding.
She was very helpful going through the menu. Amazing service by her and great food from the kitchen. 
Highly recommend this place.
reviews.title: Amazing place with excellent service

reviews.review_text: First time I went and loved everything...the atmosphere, the first food and not to mention the attention....We were attended by a Miss Melany...super friendly....
reviews.title: A first class lunch!!!!

reviews.review_text: This is the most amazing restaurant! Recommended by Peruvian friends in the UK and we absolutely LOVED it. Brilliant food, lively atmosphere and fantastic people working there. Juan Carlos, Melany and Lesley, one of the chefs behind the bar counter, were all incredibly friendly and guided us expertly through the menu!  It was very impressive watching the wonderful Lesley making intricate desserts behind the bar counter! Thank you all for the most wonderful experience.
reviews.title: Fabulous Experience

reviews.review_text: I came to see you first thing in the afternoon! The fish's head greeted me with a thud, and I feel agape. The ceviche is beautifully arranged and tension MAX. After a toast with pisco sour, we savored the fish. The staff were very pleasant, and they felt like they had received a fun and warm reception in Lima!
reviews.title: Good lunch.

reviews.review_text: Very good food, however, the volume of the music is too high. If you are going with foreigners, there are several other places much quieter and with good food.
reviews.title: VERY noisy atmosphere, not necessarily pleasant for foreigners

reviews.review_text: Exquisite Peruvian food is its splendor the flavors are exquisite , its fresh ceviches and the pisco sour too good we always come and I will always recommend it advised to order the pasta from le vongole and add hedgehogs is just an orgasm for the palate.
reviews.title: As always first rate

reviews.review_text: Excellent ceviche. Excellent Pisco Sour. Excellent service in a VERY busy restaurant! We waited 90mins for a table for two (the initial estimate was 40 mins). Reasonably priced for what you get. An enjoyable experience for sure. We skipped desert in favour of the ice cream spot across the street (creme de la creme) on the recommendation from a friend...BOSS ice cream!! Note: La Mar is only open for lunch...Be there before noon to avoid the wait!
reviews.title: Great Food!

reviews.review_text: The best ceviche there is! I love this restaurant and whenever I go to Lima, I visit it. Everything is delicious and the service is very good. No reservations are made, so go early or be prepared to wait about 20/30 minutes.
reviews.title: I always come back!

reviews.review_text: I enjoyed this restaurant. The only thing I did not like was the small portions for the price. Other than that, I enjoyed the clean and open environment!
reviews.title: Where is the Beef?

reviews.review_text:
I want to recognize the attention and good treatment to customers who go to the restaurant alone, I travel a lot and as alone. Unfortunately, you are rarely treated like large account customers and this speaks volumes of careful and personalized attention. 
Delicious and the service was super!  Everything I ate exceeded my expectations and I highly recommend!!
reviews.title: Don't hesitate, go eat there!

reviews.review_text: I researched and found a number restaurants in Lima that I wanted to try and selected this one.  I was very happy with my choice.  Food was creative and flavorful.  The server patiently explained the many spices and ingredients that were unfamiliar to me.  I was so impressed with the multiple influences of Peruvian cuisine, from indigenous people, Japanese, Chinese and African, my mouth was an explosion of flavors.  The chef/owner Gáston Acurio wrote the definitive book on Peruvian cuisine.  If the English version had a soft cover I would have bought it.
reviews.title: Memorable Peruvian cuisine

reviews.review_text:
In the Miraflores district you can have lunch at this seafood restaurant.
Excellent quality food, prices not affordable for all budgets (150 € in two for a seafood starter with lobster).
reviews.title: Absolute quality

reviews.review_text: Pisco sour cocktail is a great way to start and it’s perfect! The vibe is bustling and happy. The dining space is open and beach club like, very relaxed. Service is quite good and friendly. Food is outstanding! Ceviche has freshly prepared texture and outstanding balance of flavours. Carpaccio has an unusual preparation and also delicious. The layered potato, egg and tuna tartare is unique and recommended. Seafood rice is excellent. Ice cream is literally the best I’ve ever had. Try to reserve but despite our one hour wait without reservations, it was definitely worth it. Great dining experience, hence the endless queue of patrons waiting for their table.
reviews.title: Outstanding fresh and delectable cuisine

reviews.review_text: In general, the well-run restaurants on this platform are not always the best. Well, La Mar met all our expectations and exceeded them. The previous wait is completely worth it to enjoy this restaurant. It is not cheap, but is 25% more expensive than other locals on average, but worth every peso. All dishes well made and very good tasting. Spectacular tiger milk, ceviches too, pisco sour befitting. The very good service and the party atmosphere inside make it an entertaining experience. Anyway, I would definitely go back to this restaurant on a next visit to Lima.
reviews.title: Excellent

reviews.review_text:
I've had the opportunity to travel and sit at the best tables, but as the
Sea, there is not, perhaps it is something sentimental or simply affinity, its concept, its raw material, its people and those flavors that always fill you.
I'd come back a thousand times
reviews.title: The Sea a thousand times

reviews.review_text:
This is a walk in restaurant and they don't take reservations. The first time we went we arrived just before 1 p.m. on a Friday. The place was packed and we and had to wait about 30-40 minutes at the bar before getting a table. The food, drinks and service was amazing. We were so happy we went back when we got back to Lima after our tour around Peru. This time we arrived at about 1:45 p.m and waited over 2 hours for a table with no room to wait inside the restaurant. Food and drinks were still good, but we were miserable after the long wait.

You should definitely go to this restaurant, but if you can't get there before 1 p.m. just don't bother going at all. This place is packed, mainly with locals who never seem to leave. Pick out somewhere else and don't waste your afternoon waiting for a table here. It is good, but it's not worth that.
reviews.title: Great place when you get seated...

reviews.review_text:
It is among the best restaurants in Lima for its gastronomic level.
You always have to go with reservation to enjoy its exquisite flavors.,
reviews.title: Synonymous with good eating

reviews.review_text:
Despite the queue you have to wait, it is worth it because you know that dishes will not disappoint. The ceviche, the octopus, all very good. But if there's one unmissable, it's the devilfish. The uglier, the richer. I ask whenever I can.
Go early that from 1:30 the wait is already a little long. If you could book it, or avoid that queue, you would give it all 5 stars.
reviews.title: Very good as ever

reviews.review_text:
No booking, you turn up and queue.  Slot available at the bar, would have been 1 hour wait for a table at 13:00 on a Friday.

We had our meal at the bar, with a number of fish watching us.  Really nice food.  Chilled atmosphere.
reviews.title: We had our meal at the bar, with a number of fish watching us.  Really nice food.  Chilled atmosphere.

reviews.review_text:
Great and friendly service service ! One can not reserve a table ! 
We got there just after opening at 12.02 on a Friday . No line at that point but at 1 pm there was a lot of people waiting for a table . They gave us some chips and three different dipping sauces  and a corn snack to start with . They have lots of cocktails to choose from . I just had a zero Corona . 
I had a ceviche taco as a starter , 2 small and delicious tacos and then a white fish ceviche as a main course  , Medium  hot . I was completely full  . . My husband had picarones as a dessert - a sweet potato donut with a kind of warm honey for dipping . Really nice lunch and so think a lot of other people as well . They have many tables but I recommend you to be there at opening for lunch
reviews.title: Delicious ceviche in a nice setting .open for lunch only !

reviews.review_text: Excellent wonderful food, very good service? The person who attended me, did wonderfully the very good recommendations
reviews.title: Very good

reviews.review_text: The reviews I've read about this restaurant don't do it justice.  My wife and I are seafood lovers and definitely, we ate some Top-rated seafood dishes we've ever tasted.  The treatment of the waiters, the information and recommendations provided, the organization and cleanliness of the place during our visit, and the delicious drinks, made our afternoon an unforgettable one.
reviews.title: Delights of the sea in every spoonful!

reviews.review_text: Very peculiar place, very cool! Super friendly waiters! Welcome chips with sauces, very delicious! The best... the ‘poke’ with rice and different raw fish and seafood with a spiced mayonnaise, AMAZING. Delicacy dessert, very delicious! Great to start our trip through Peru.
reviews.title: Ceviche and rich fish!

reviews.review_text:
The best ceviche and oysters in Lima.
Fresh oysters, fresh fishing and sea chorizo a delight.
Balanced and beautiful sour.
The slightly traditional jelly compared to the different and peculiar snacks and entrees.
Friendly atmosphere and Flower our very friendly and nearby area.
reviews.title: Marine experience

reviews.review_text: Must be Lima's best ceviche. It was very good. We also ate ravioli and pasta gratin with prawns. All absolutely fantastic. Nice environment and fantastic service.
reviews.title: Best in Lima?

reviews.review_text: A very large selection of dishes, everything proved delicious. The portions are huge) Service at the highest level, friendly staff, delicious compliments on the table. Hostes originally said the table was waiting 40 minutes, but we were locked up after 20. I recommend it!
reviews.title: Great restaurant

reviews.review_text: Absolutely sensational in every respect.  Just go.  We were with friends who were local, so that helped with the language.  We went on a Monday shortly after noon and there was no line.  The meal, the service, the drinks,...everything was like the best dream ever.
reviews.title: WOW! WOW! WOW!

reviews.review_text: Relaxed and cheerful environment offering excellent Peruvian food! Visitors to Lima who would like to taste the seafood cuisine of Peru can not fail to visit this restaurant.
reviews.title: Unmissable for visitors to Lima

reviews.review_text: We loved this restaurant. Seafood is fresh and flavorful. We tried the crab in sauce, and the grilled seafood platter. Both were great. We even returned another day. I recommend to get there when they open at 12pm to avoid long waiting time. It gets busy
reviews.title: Excellent!

reviews.review_text:
Great cebiche, Daniel the guy who followed us and 'was great at advising and also indicating what I could eat gluten free being celiac... excellent pisco sour!
Highly recommended! We moved the flight to Arequipa only to come and have lunch here after the flight from Italy! Exceptional
reviews.title: Cuddle between flights

reviews.review_text:
Amazing food and cocktails! Nice vibes and music as well.
We were looking for the best ceviche in town and we were satisfied!
reviews.title: 5 stars ceviche!

reviews.review_text: Been here few years ago and decided to visit absolutely did not disappoint and only get better you'll have to have a reservation if you want to have a lunch but if you don't mind sitting in the bar it's a little bit easier to fight. It's open only for lunch so there is high demand for this place. Order the whole fish,  Chita a la parilla, You come covered with chimichurri with capers They face is amazing every bite exploding your mouth It's flaky it's fresh and it's really amazing dish for dessert I have the chocolate mousse over lukuma mousse, it served in the Coco pod and have roasted quinoa on top amazing combination beautifully presented and really good.
reviews.title: Earthbound Adventures tour

reviews.review_text:
We went without Reservation and were treated without problems, but the ideal is to make a Reservation due to the movement. The food is tasty and made with quality ingredients; it is worth following the suggestions of the house. The service is very good. And don't forget to try the desserts, it's worth every calorie.

Super recommend
reviews.title: Lunch

reviews.review_text:
After 5 days hiking at Cusco, all foods is so good. Among them, I missed La Mar Cheviche plates.  Love Sashimi but now on Cheviche. Tried all their cheviche. Went early and wait out side bench. It worth. 
Spent $546.00
reviews.title: Love their dishes.

reviews.review_text: Extremely over priced, two glasses of house Chardonnay, 12 oysters, one soup came out to 200 US DOLLARS that’s ridiculous! We live in Miami and only come close to that when out at Michelin star top tier restaurants. Way over priced to eat at what looks like a back yard with a tarp over it and bamboo sticks. Service was amazing which was the only positive take away. Stay far away from this money vacuum. Their food was comparable to riconcito Latinos found in Miami. So so so disappointing, other spots in Peru blow this place out of the water and are far far far cheaper. PANCHITA owned by the same chef as le mar is far better and cheaper and much nicer ambiance. The most disappointing experience in our time at Peru. What a let down.
reviews.title: Stay away over priced and way over hyped

reviews.review_text:
We found this place when searching through the best restaurants in Lima. We visited after a few days of travel in Peru. And we are so glad that we went. 

The food was great - the seafood was fresh and delicious. We had Mixto Ceviche, Empanadas, Conchitas a la parmasena and Arron con Mariscos among the four of us and that was plentiful. The cocktails were nice, if only had more ice than alcohol :) The ambience and music was great as was the service. The price was reasonable for the quality of the food (one would easily pay 2x in US)

It should be on the must-go list for any foodie visiting Lima.
reviews.title: A top Lima restaurant

reviews.review_text: It's the richest cebiche we've ever eaten! Excellent service despite the crowded local. I recommend the cebiche chalaco and the traditional dessert sigh...you will not regret it!
reviews.title: La Mar!

reviews.review_text: A huge selection of ceviche, best we have had! Was so delicious, if you are looking for one place to have ceviche in Lima, this is it.
reviews.title: Best ceviche

reviews.review_text: Simply a great visit by a solo traveler — decor, vibe, service and above all, excellent food. The flavors were wonderful as was the Pisco.
reviews.title: Wonderful Lunch

reviews.review_text: Extraordinary option to try Peruvian cuisine. Your ceviche is unmissable, anyone you order is amazing. Service if you leave some to be desired. I think it closes very early.
reviews.title: Unmissable

reviews.review_text:
Back in 2015 I was lucky to visit the newly opened La Mar in Buenos Aires and was blown away with the flavours.   This was my first experience of not just cevice but Peruvian food.  We returned for our last night and this time met the chef and owner Anthony Vasquez who generously spend time with many diners.   
I have a shot time in Peru and learnt that La Mar was only a few miles from my accommodation so it was a must. My experience was even better. Willie looked after me and gave me some great recommendations.   On learning I loved scallops, he gave me 2 smaller servings of 2 very different scallop starters; the first served in lightly spiced oil and the second with parmesan foam; both delicious. I asked for bread to make sure none of the oils went to waste.   
My main was the prawns with fettuccine and a rich sauce.  The portion was way too much so tonight's dinner will be a real treat.  
I did try the home made ice cream. I didn't quite catch the name but is made from avocado which was another recommendation from Willie. I wasn't sure what to expect but a smooth and firm texture was very paletable.  The taste was very similar to butterscotch so was a delight.  
To drink I had the sunset cocktail made with Singleton, lime and bitters; perfect for this Scottish whisky lover.  I also tried the Pisco Sour and will definitely be having more of this.  
The food was outstanding and service attentive and efficient. Willie is an asset to la Mar as I would probably never have chosen the gems he offered.   The highlight, was meeting Anthony again after 7.5 years.  What a lovely and talented man.   Please open a la Mar in the UK.

reviews.review_text: The first question is: are you interested in good food or posting on social media? I was interested in the first one and it was a disappointment. Looking at the comments from other customers, it seems like we went to different restaurants. I've been to this restaurant 3 times. Two in Bogotá where I only ate ceviche (which wasn't that good, very acidic and with 40% volume of onion) and yesterday in Lima which was a total disappointment. We ordered a combination of 3 ceviches to try and none of the 3 impressed, in fact the traditional one impressed negatively due to the exaggerated acidity and the small quantity served. We then ordered a main course which was a total ruin, with a combination of sauces that in a rough comparison was like serving a very thin steak with spicy tomato sauce on one side of the plate and mustard on the other (these 2 sauces don't even match the stick). It was a fish fillet about 1.5 cm thick (as if it were a thin fish tail) with prawns and a spicy red sauce and on the other half of the plate there was a greenish sauce that in no way matched the first. I left the restaurant nauseated. I can't understand how a famous chef would come up with such a crazy combination. A total frustration. Furthermore, it is very expensive, because if it were good it would already be expensive but justifiable, but if it was bad it becomes very expensive. I don't recommend it nor will I return. This dish is disgusting and the ceviche of more than 15 restaurants in Peru (including roadside self-service for tourists) by the famous chef Gaston was the weakest. Furthermore, the combo of 3 small portions of ceviche cost 130 soles. In other restaurants you would eat much better for half the price or even less. It's worth mentioning that we were also at chicha, the famous chef's restaurant in Cuzco, and the starter (an alpaca fillet) was very good but the second course was also disappointing. It was a mixture of chicken, pork (both tasteless) and lamb (the only one that was saved) in a strong sauce immersed in a sea of potatoes. Another disappointment. We ate in wonderful restaurants in Cuzco (chef elmer (I forgot the name of the restaurant), pisoc (rest la ruta), ollantaytambo (restaurant verônica), all unforgettable and that gave the famous chef a run for his money. In lima the best restaurant for ceviche is called Se punto azul, in Miraflores. Simply sensational mixed ceviche, well served and at a fair price, so much so that it's crowded all the time. Now if your goal is to post your photos, go to the famous one that gets the most likes.

When we arrived we were offered seats at the bar but if wanted a table then waiting time of 30 minutes. They have waiting area also.

The ceviche was really class ! But the dish that we found absolutely outstanding was the grilled scallops and prawn ( planchette de con) and we also ordered another fish dish- milanessa pobra .
We tried chilcano de pisca which is pisco sour but without eggs.
We are even planning to go back to this restaurant before we fly back home and that tells you how good the food is in this famous Cebicheria.
